provenance.sourceName: NASA FIRMS SP · Kazakhstan QA calendar · Aqua + NOAA-20 · 2024–2025
provenance.processingMethod: Full country QA cohort: type0, MODIS>=30, VIIRS nominal/high; exact-date calendar; frozen 2024 OLS only on matched groups, separate from raw records.
limitations: Two years only: no historical anomaly baseline, critical-period prediction or forecast.
Per-sensor detections are not unique fires. Do not sum sensors into a fire count.
All request windows covered; actual satellite/cloud-free coverage unknown. No detections is not zero activity.
Summed instantaneous FRP is not daily energy; matched groups are a selected subset.
Week bins start January 1, are not ISO weeks; W53 is a short tail with exact dates.

MODIS.limitations: Низкая чувствительность к малым очагам (<1000 м); шкала достоверности 0–100%.

VIIRS.limitations: Архив начинается с 2012 г.; категориальная достоверность low / nominal / high.
